_readme: Gold set for retrieval eval. Each query lists one or more acceptable gold conditions; a result counts as correct if it matches ANY gold entry. A gold entry matches on every field it specifies: document_id (exact), condition (condition number, exact), title (case-insensitive substring of the condition title). Omit document_id to accept the condition from any contract. Set reviewed=true once a human has confirmed the label.
